title: SES Extends EGNOS GEO-1 Satellite Service to Power Precise Navigation Across Europe
summary: The agreement ensures Europe’s satellite-based augmentation continues enhancing navigation for aviation and other critical users and lowering emissions LUXEMBOURG & BRUSSELS — SES, a leading space solutions company, and the European Union Agency for the Space Programme (EUSPA) today announced an extension of the European Geostationary Navigation Overlay Service (EGNOS) GEO-1 satellite service agreement through […]
